description: This file contains testing utilities and classes for Flask applications, including custom test clients, environment builders, and CLI runners, used for testing Flask apps and their components.

classes.name: EnvironBuilder
classes.description: A subclass of Werkzeug's EnvironBuilder that initializes defaults from a Flask application and provides JSON serialization.

classes.name: FlaskClient
classes.description: A custom test client for Flask that extends Werkzeug's Client, adding session transaction support and context preservation.

classes.name: FlaskCliRunner
classes.description: A CLI runner for testing Flask CLI commands, extending Click's CliRunner.

methods.name: json_dumps
methods.description: Serializes an object to a JSON string using the Flask app's JSON configuration.

methods.name: _get_werkzeug_version
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of Werkzeug, caching the result.

methods.name: session_transaction
methods.description: Provides a context manager to modify the session during testing.

methods.name: _copy_environ
methods.description: Creates a copy of the environment, optionally preserving context.

methods.name: _request_from_builder_args
methods.description: Constructs a request object from builder arguments.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Performs a test request, handling various input types and managing context stack.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables context management for the test client.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Disables context management for the test client.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Runs a CLI command in an isolated environment for testing.
